import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    m1, m2, m3, w1, w2, w3 = map(int, data)
    weighted_sum = 0
    weighted_sum += m1 * w1
    weighted_sum += m2 * w2
    weighted_sum += m3 * w3
    total_weight = w1 + w2 + w3
    avg = float(weighted_sum) / float(total_weight)
    print(f"{avg:.2f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
